leakage_notes: No feature is nearly perfectly correlated with Diagnosis. That does not prove the labels are independent of the features by construction, only that a trivial one-to-one mapping is not visible.
observations: The file contains 10000 rows and 7 columns.
The imbalance is moderate, not extreme; stratified splits and class-weight options are still appropriate.
Chronic_Pain_Level and BMI have thousands of unique values, which is consistent with continuous (possibly generated) measurements rather than a short ordinal scale.
BMI equals 15.0 in 225 rows, suggesting a lower clip. Chronic_Pain_Level hits 0.0 in 71 rows and 10.0 in 56 rows.
Age is only weakly associated with Diagnosis in this file; hormone abnormality and chronic pain show the largest (still modest) associations.
Feature definitions are not accompanied by a data dictionary in the repository. Coding of binary fields should be treated as file-specific, not clinical standard.
Provenance is uncertain. This project treats the table as a structured Kaggle-style research file, not as a verified clinical registry.

provenance.source_claim: Supplied locally as a structured endometriosis table intended for academic ML work.
unknowns: Collection site, years, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and ethics approval are not documented in-file.
It is not known whether Diagnosis is surgically confirmed, clinically coded, self-reported, or synthetically assigned.
Binary feature definitions (irregularity, hormone abnormality, infertility) have no codebook.
The combination of clipped BMI, dense unique continuous values, and modest linear associations is compatible with simulated or heavily processed data.
Licence and redistribution terms were not bundled with the CSV; the packaged ZIP therefore omits the dataset file.

calibration.note: Reliability diagram and expected calibration error were estimated on the held-out test set after model selection. If ECE is high, treat outputs as ranking scores rather than probabilities.

metadata.selection_rule: Hyperparameters and the deployed algorithm are chosen from training-set inner stratified ROC-AUC only. A composite of ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, F1 and recall is stored for reporting; it is not used to pick the saved model, so the test set stays isolated from model selection. Accuracy is reported but is not a selection criterion.
metadata.disclaimer: ENDOCARE is an academic prototype. Outputs are experimental model scores, not diagnoses. A low score does not rule out endometriosis.

calibration.note: Reliability diagram and expected calibration error were estimated on the held-out test set after model selection. If ECE is high, treat outputs as ranking scores rather than probabilities.

limitations: The dataset provenance, label generation process and feature codebooks are not verified.
Performance estimates describe this file under a random stratified split, not prospective clinical use.
Six tabular features cannot capture the clinical heterogeneity of endometriosis.
Calibration was assessed after model selection; treat scores conservatively.
SHAP and permutation importance describe model associations, not biological causation.
